additionalTopics.title: Academic integrity
additionalTopics.summary: The2025 student disciplinary regulation provides possible warnings, demerit/probation or expulsion according to the applicable violation and severity. General research-misconduct clauses require the academic committee’s determination. These are not automatic penalties for any AI use. Before an adverse disciplinary decision, students are told facts/reasons/basis and may state and defend their case. Before probation/expulsion they are told of the hearing-request right. Major decisions undergo legal review and the stated university decision process. The2026 appeal regulation covers specified enrolment/status/withdrawal/discipline decisions: written appeal within10 days from receipt. Initial screening is3 working days; corrections requested within5 working days. Written reply normally15 days, extendable15 with approval; corrected applications restart that reply clock. External provincial appeal is15 days after receipt of review opinion. The2026 rule repeals2015; unspecified “days” are not converted to working days.
